guidance.summary: Execute planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over 5 years
guidance.speaker: MR. NIYANT MARU
guidance.quote: We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years, which will further enhance our capabilities, scale and innovation.

guidance.summary: Achieve 8% to 10% FMEG EBITDA margin by FY30
guidance.speaker: MR. NIYANT MARU
guidance.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter stood at 4.1%, in line with our Project Spring trajectory of achieving 8% to 10% EBITDA margins by financial year 2030.

guidance.summary: Achieve greater than 10% contribution from exports by FY30
guidance.speaker: MR. NIYANT MARU
guidance.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.

guidance.summary: Maintain annual capex guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion
guidance.speaker: MR. NIYANT MARU
guidance.quote: During FY26, we incurred capex of INR 14.8 billion, in line with our annual guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion per annum.

guidance.summary: Expect 11% to 13% EBITDA margin over the long term
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: So again, that's a very calibrated guidance which we have given that over long term, we should expect 11% to 13% EBITDA margin. and in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA. and we'll continue to deliver that kind of margins.

guidance.summary: Expect 12% to 14% EBITDA margin in near to mid term
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: So again, that's a very calibrated guidance which we have given that over long term, we should expect 11% to 13% EBITDA margin. and in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA. and we'll continue to deliver that kind of margins.

guidance.summary: Execute INR 6,000 crores to INR 8,000 crores capex by FY30
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: And we are continuing to expand, again, in line with our Project Spring guidance of INR 6,000 crores to INR 8,000 crores capex by financial year 2030.

guidance.summary: Invest INR 1,200 crores to INR 1,600 crores capex every year
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: And we are continuing to pump INR 1,200 crores to INR 1,600 crores every year, adding capacity.
